basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old living in Toronto who loves fishing, craft beer, and exploring herbal supplements. I've been an avid Redditor for a little over a year now. During the weekdays, I work as a software developer, but on weekends, you'll find me either fishing at Lake Ontario or checking out new local breweries. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel and indulge in my hobbies. I'm usually online in the evenings or late at night, especially when I'm unwinding with a good beer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My knowledge in craft beer comes from years of home brewing and attending beer festivals. I recently started exploring herbal supplements like ashwagandha, driven by personal interest and online research.
